explanation: Backtrack through unused bit patterns, trying one-bit changes in low-to-high bit order. Keep the first complete sequence whose final code also differs from the first by one bit.
timeComplexity: O(b·2^b) along the generated reflected Gray-code traversal
spaceComplexity: O(2^b) codes, visited entries and recursion depth
